queue.title: US targets Iran’s crypto sector, cites over $100M in oil-linked payments
queue.summary: The US Treasury expanded sanctions to Iran’s digital asset sector, alleging a UAE-based broker processed over $100 million in crypto for oil sales.

queue.title: BNB Chain activates Pasteur hard fork to strengthen bridge security
queue.summary: BNB Chain activates the Pasteur hard fork on BSC, closing bridge and validator security gaps while targeting greater transaction capacity.
